title: You Waste $1,600/Year in Food — Stores Plan It
hook: You think you're bad at grocery shopping. You're not — grocery chains spend billions engineering the exact purchases you're about to throw away.
angle: Reframes food waste as a corporate strategy, not personal failure — exposes three specific store tricks that guarantee overbuy
audience: Anyone who buys groceries and has ever thrown away leftovers or expired food — essentially everyone
key_numbers: Bulk buying increases purchase 50% but consumption only 30%
$218 billion wasted annually in the US
80 billion pounds of food trashed from retailer-set expiration dates
